topics.title: Biomass Feedstock Selection & Moisture Characterization
topics.objective: Evaluate agricultural residues (crop stalks, wood chips, nutshells) for moisture content and lignin-to-cellulose ratios.
topics.exercise: Calculate net feedstock requirements to generate 10 tons of stable biochar given 25% biomass moisture content.

topics.title: Slow Pyrolysis Thermal Kinetics & Residence Time
topics.objective: Model thermochemical decomposition under oxygen-limited conditions between 450°C and 700°C.
topics.exercise: Formulate kiln temperature ramping profiles optimizing carbon yield and minimizing volatile syngas fractions.

topics.title: Surface Area, Porosity & Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC)
topics.objective: Characterize micropore volume and functional carboxyl groups that enhance nutrient and water retention in degraded soils.
topics.exercise: Design a lab protocol measuring ammonium and nitrate adsorption kinetics in biochar-amended loam soil.

topics.title: Carbon Removal MRV (Measurement, Reporting, and Verification)
topics.objective: Quantify durable carbon sequestration according to Puro.earth and Verra carbon crediting methodologies.
topics.exercise: Build an MRV spreadsheet model calculating verified carbon units (VCUs) with cradle-to-gate lifecycle emissions.

topics.title: Soil Application Agronomics & Microbial Inoculation
topics.objective: Blend biochar with organic compost and mycorrhizal inoculants to charge mineral surfaces before field spreading.
topics.exercise: Draft field trial specifications comparing crop root biomass between raw biochar and pre-inoculated biochar plots.
